claims.text: A knight in battered plate armour rides a huge black dragon low over a burning battlefield in a cinematic sequence.
The smoke and ember haze, firelit black scales, soot-dulled battered steel, collapsing siege line, and distant fires are added atmospheric details within the requested scene.

speakers.description: The knight, an onscreen armoured rider with an urgent, wind-battered presence.

subjects.description: A huge black dragon with massive wings, black scales, and a wet firelit sheen, flying low and then climbing away from the battlefield.
A knight in battered plate armour, soot-dulled and dented, braced on the dragon's back with a gauntlet locked to the saddle.
A burning battlefield of collapsed siege lines, shattered engines, broken palisades, smoke columns, embers, and distant fires.

summary.text: and then climbs clear of the smoke.

style: Cinematic dark-fantasy realism, 16:9 widescreen, low aerial dragon flight over a burning battlefield, smoke and ember haze, firelit black scales and battered steel, natural motion, filmic contrast and depth.
